sourcePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page direction comp, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render the first viewport and the start of the next section for the Clinimed Odontologia institutional website, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese, no browser frame. It must be clearly a trustworthy multidisciplinary dental clinic in Votuporanga with a direct WhatsApp evaluation action.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must remain recognizable. Image 2 contributes only real clinic spatial cues; replace or omit any old PLUG branding.
Concept: Percurso de Cuidado — borrow the clarity and visual confidence of excellent Brazilian public wayfinding, translated into an inviting private clinic. Do not use a standard split hero. A bold continuous green route line begins at the logo, travels through the headline and four clearly named treatment destinations, then arrives at a prominent WhatsApp appointment panel. The floating navigation is a refined transparent glass bubble labeled “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos”, plus “Agende sua avaliação”.
Content: “Tudo o que o seu sorriso precisa, no mesmo caminho.” “Mais de 40 procedimentos com planejamento integrado e atendimento humanizado.” Destinations: “Ortodontia”, “Implantes”, “Estética”, “Clínica geral”. Primary action: “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”. Supporting facts: “Desde 2010”, “Votuporanga/SP”, “Seg. a sex. · 07h–19h”. Begin the next section with “Encontre o cuidado certo”.
Visual law: clean ivory field, dark forest-green typography, vivid lime route line, small areas of enamel gray, real documentary clinic photography as inset windows; robust contemporary grotesk, generous scale, purposeful signage details. The route line is the single dominant move.
Constraints: functional website, accessible contrast, no generic cards, no playful map pins everywhere, no dental stock smiles, no invented claims or prices, no extra logos, no watermark.
